summary: Best-of-4 RAG sets, Swift coverage scorer selects
hypothesis: Sampling RAG-augmented drafts at four temperatures and picking the one with the best dimension coverage should outperform a single-shot RAG draft, because a wider sampling spread raises the chance that at least one set covers all required dimensions.
technique: Four parallel on-device RAG-augmented generation calls at temperatures [0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 1.0] produce four candidate question sets; a deterministic Swift scorer (weighted dimension-span: budget/timeline/scale/location/current-state bonuses, redundancy + already-stated penalties) then picks the best-covering set without any model involvement.

stages.text: Swift coverage scorer picks best set
